shared_or_similar_visual_information: A shaded region with a plotted boundary. On the left, use the gray half-plane below the solid horizontal line. On the right, use the gray patch underneath the horizontal axis between the blue and orange curves, immediately to the right of the vertical axis.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: It consists of points satisfying the lower-side inequality, including equality along the solid line. Right image: It selects the area between the two traces from the vertical axis to their first intersection on the right.
Rationales: The left selection describes an allowable side or range relative to a plotted comparison. The right fill selects a gap between curves whose height is found by subtraction for an area calculation.
